title: Working in Chicago and California
summary: Gabriel names Chicago clubs and says he always worked, then goes to California and San Diego after leaving McShann, recording on Capitol.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: I don't remember Chicago that way. Yeah. And I don't remember many places. Yeah. Did you ever go to the Victory Club there?
I don't know, that's just one place I can think of. No, I don't think.
Jeep Robinson used to play there.

Yeah, but most of the time I was in Chicago, I was always working. Yeah. Because we were Jeep, and a woman playing piano, she used to sing with Duke Elminton. I got a picture, I look at her picture the other day. Beverly Thomas, I think. Beverly, Beverly something, her name.
